heading: EXT. DUSTY HITCHING POST OUTSIDE THE GENERAL STORE - DAY

units.text: EXT. DUSTY HITCHING POST OUTSIDE THE GENERAL STORE - DAY
Heat.
A tumbleweed rolls by like it has somewhere to be.
Kip, 17, leans on the rail with his hat pulled low.
He is staring at his phone like it owes him money.
Two steps away, Kim, 17, doing the exact same thing, is not looking at him.
CLOSE ON Kip's screen.
INSERT - the group chat.
ON PHONE: @Kip_Rides: so ur the one thats always online ON PHONE: @KimInTheSaddle: ur the one who left me on read for 3 weeks
Neither of them move.
ANGLE ON the road.
A third rider trots up, Jo, 18, in a duster two sizes too big.
He ties the horse and takes a long time doing it.
So. That's the whole group then.
units.name: JO

units.text: Guess so.
units.name: KIP

units.text: Guess so.
units.name: KIM

units.text: Silence.
A fly buzzes.
We could get a soda. Theres a place.
units.name: JO

units.text: Its closed.
units.name: KIP

units.text: Its a saloon, it's always closed in the day.
units.name: JO

units.text: She laughs, short and cracked, and looks at her boots.
He kicks the dirt.
Neither one says what they are thinking.
She types something, deletes it, types something else.
WE SEE Kip's phone light up.
INSERT - ON PHONE: @KimInTheSaddle: ok this is weird
Kip glances up.
Kim glances up.
They both look away at the same time.
Yeah.
units.name: KIP

units.text: You two want me to leave or
units.name: JO

units.text: No.
units.name: KIM

units.text: No, stay.
units.name: KIP

units.text: He shifts his weight.
She pulls her sleeve over her hand.
It stays quiet for a while, the way a long road does.
BACK TO SCENE
Okay, soda, I'll buy. Come on.
units.name: JO

units.text: He walks first.
They follow, a few steps apart, phones dark in their hands.
